under the 33 kW shed point (Electro E3)
1. Equipment grounding conductor continuous through every jumper; bonding jumpers across truck pivots.
2. Jumpers: inline locking connectors rated ≥ 200 A, strain relief, interlocked so no live pins exposed.
3. Genset 35 kW continuous (ISO 8528 COP) 1-ph, ≤ 900 kg; tender reservation X1060-2768 (≤ 1,775) × 800 × 1,000 (rev TB-3,
basis PTI-38). Cabinet: tender R wall NEMA 3R X2820-3780; listed 200 A 3R UL 1008 ATS w/ integral main; main bkr QOM22225NRB encl. handle ≤ Z1639.
4. ERV RenewAire HE05IN 120 V (880×956×307, 43 kg) in low roof pod ≤ 3,450 ARL; OA/EA louvres separated; MERV 13.
5. Emergency lighting and exit marking battery-backed 90 min per coach (plan EL1).
6. Electrical design to be reviewed/inspected per NFPA 70 and County; wiring by licensed electrician.
